acceptance_checks.given: .spectra/changes/calendar-pr47-rescue remains in progress without explicit owner supersession
acceptance_checks.when: the implementation changed-file inventory is evaluated
acceptance_checks.then: implementation SHALL make no edit to an overlapping calendar or event file
acceptance_checks.verify_method: gate: pre-implementation change-state check plus changed-file inventory

acceptance_checks.given: an Event detail response is produced
acceptance_checks.then: every event-detail capability SHALL be projected by jin-core

acceptance_checks.given: an active Jin-owned non-recurring Event without an originating Task
acceptance_checks.then: its detail projection SHALL report display_kind=event

acceptance_checks.given: an Event carries derived_from, including a missing or inactive Task reference
acceptance_checks.then: its detail projection SHALL report display_kind=time-block

acceptance_checks.given: a recurring Event from any source
acceptance_checks.when: its M1 detail capabilities are projected
acceptance_checks.then: its M1 detail projection SHALL report can_edit=false

acceptance_checks.given: a Google-authoritative Event
acceptance_checks.when: its M1 detail capabilities are projected
acceptance_checks.then: its M1 detail projection SHALL report can_delete=false

acceptance_checks.given: an Event has one or more overlapping mutation restrictions
acceptance_checks.then: its detail projection SHALL choose the read-only reason by cancelled → recurring_milestone_1 → external authority/source precedence

acceptance_checks.given: a legacy Task file without agenda_bucket
acceptance_checks.then: the Task SHALL deserialize with no explicit agenda bucket

acceptance_checks.given: a Task has agenda_bucket=flexible
acceptance_checks.when: a new Time block commits successfully
acceptance_checks.then: the Task SHALL have no explicit agenda bucket

acceptance_checks.given: a Task has agenda_bucket=flexible
acceptance_checks.then: the Task SHALL have no explicit agenda bucket

acceptance_checks.given: a Task has agenda_bucket=flexible
acceptance_checks.when: the Task becomes cancelled or deleted
acceptance_checks.then: the Task SHALL have no explicit agenda bucket

acceptance_checks.given: a mutable Time block is the last active block of an active originating Task
acceptance_checks.then: its projection SHALL report can_return_task_to_flexible=true

acceptance_checks.given: another active Time block derives from the same Task
acceptance_checks.then: return-to-flexible eligibility SHALL be false

acceptance_checks.given: a Time block has a missing or inactive originating Task
acceptance_checks.then: return-to-flexible eligibility SHALL be false

acceptance_checks.given: an eligible Time block and return_to_flexible=false
acceptance_checks.then: only the Event SHALL become cancelled

acceptance_checks.given: an eligible Time block and return_to_flexible=true
acceptance_checks.then: the originating Task SHALL have agenda_bucket=flexible

acceptance_checks.given: a Time block removal targets an originating Task
acceptance_checks.then: Time block removal SHALL preserve the originating Task identity, due date, list, status, priority, body, section, tags, position, reminders, and parent

acceptance_checks.given: return eligibility changes after detail load
acceptance_checks.then: the core SHALL reject the stale return request without partially applying it

acceptance_checks.given: a crash is injected between canonical writes
acceptance_checks.then: canonical Event and Task state SHALL converge to the journaled transaction invariant

acceptance_checks.given: a completed remove transaction
acceptance_checks.then: the operation SHALL return the canonical completed result without additional semantic mutation

acceptance_checks.given: a Google provider payload is mapped from Jin canonical state
acceptance_checks.then: Google provider payloads SHALL omit agenda_bucket and Jin-local context edges

acceptance_checks.given: event detail is visible
acceptance_checks.when: the detail layout and accessibility tree are evaluated
acceptance_checks.then: the global Add Event control SHALL be hidden from layout and accessibility trees

acceptance_checks.given: a mutable plain Event detail
acceptance_checks.then: the header SHALL expose Edit and Delete actions

acceptance_checks.given: a mutable Time block detail
acceptance_checks.then: the destructive header action SHALL be labelled Remove

acceptance_checks.given: an eligible Time block removal confirmation
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL show an unchecked Return task to flexible agenda checkbox

acceptance_checks.given: an ineligible Time block removal confirmation
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL contain no return-to-flexible checkbox

acceptance_checks.given: event edit mode contains unsaved changes
acceptance_checks.then: canonical Event data SHALL remain unchanged

acceptance_checks.given: a detail mutation succeeds
acceptance_checks.then: the detail SHALL refetch canonical Event data before rendering success

acceptance_checks.given: detail was opened from a calendar mode, date, and scroll position
acceptance_checks.then: that calendar state SHALL be restored
acceptance_checks.verify_method: Playwright MCP: calendar detail return-state scenario

acceptance_checks.given: the system locale is active
acceptance_checks.then: event detail copy and temporal formatting SHALL use the system locale

acceptance_checks.given: a supported language override is selected
acceptance_checks.then: its visible and accessibility copy SHALL use the override

acceptance_checks.given: a Google-source event detail offers local context actions
acceptance_checks.when: the local context section is rendered
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL display the approved Private to Jin privacy copy

acceptance_checks.given: the native detail surface at supported widths, themes, scaling, languages, and reduced-motion settings
acceptance_checks.then: the summary hierarchy SHALL remain readable without clipped primary actions or unintended horizontal scrolling
acceptance_checks.verify_method: evidence: Playwright artifacts plus owner native Tauri visual sign-off

acceptance_checks.given: a crash is injected during create-Time-block after any staged write boundary
acceptance_checks.then: application-visible Task and Event state SHALL converge before create success is returned

acceptance_checks.given: a create or remove request reuses a completed operation ID
acceptance_checks.then: the core SHALL return the original semantic result without creating or applying a second mutation

acceptance_checks.given: a create or remove operation passed canonical precondition checks
acceptance_checks.when: its first canonical write is attempted
acceptance_checks.then: a locked durable recovery record SHALL already contain every target before image, post image, and SHA-256 hash

acceptance_checks.given: an affected Task or Event canonical read is requested while an operation is incomplete
acceptance_checks.when: the read path resolves canonical data
acceptance_checks.then: the read path SHALL run operation recovery before returning canonical data

acceptance_checks.given: an incomplete operation target matches a staged before or post hash
acceptance_checks.then: recovery SHALL apply the deterministic mapping {before: roll-forward, post: rollback}

acceptance_checks.given: an incomplete operation target matches neither staged before nor staged post hash
acceptance_checks.then: recovery SHALL persist a blocked conflict without canonical overwrite, index refresh, or sync enqueue
